name: pixellab_generate
description:
Generate game-ready PIXEL ART via the Pixel Lab API: static sprites/props, full directional characters, tilesets, and map objects. Output PNGs (and multi-file characters) are saved under assets/pixellab/ and indexed in assets/pixellab/manifest.json — then wire them into the game with edit_file/write_file.

Async operations (characters, tilesets, map/objects) return a job_id; either pass wait_seconds to block, or call pixellab_poll later. Sync operations (images, isometric tile) import immediately.

CRITICAL — almost every operation REQUIRES image_size in params as an object {"width":N,"height":N} (pixel art is small: 16/32/48/64/128). Put endpoint-specific fields in "params"; supply reference/init/color/style images via "image_inputs" (API field name → project file path, auto-converted to base64).

REQUIRED FIELDS PER OPERATION (top-level "description" is used unless noted; everything else goes in "params"):
- image_pixflux / image_pixen / image_bitforge: description + params.image_size. (single static sprite/prop, SYNC.)
- character_v3: description. params.image_size optional; view default "low top-down", template_id default "mannequin". (ASYNC, returns character — use pixellab_manage download_character or pixellab_poll.)
- character_4dir / character_8dir: description + params.image_size. (ASYNC directional character.)
- tileset / tileset_topdown: NO description field — instead params.lower_description AND params.upper_description (both required), optional params.transition_description, params.tile_size {width,height}. (ASYNC.)
- tileset_sidescroller: NO description — params.lower_description (required), optional params.transition_description, params.tile_size. (ASYNC.)
- tileset_isometric: description + params.image_size. (SYNC.)
- map_object: description (params.image_size default 128x128). (ASYNC.)
- object_1dir / object_8dir: description. (ASYNC.)
Common optional params: negative_description, view, direction, outline, shading, detail, text_guidance_scale, no_background, seed.

description.description: Main text prompt describing the asset (maps to the endpoint's description field).

params.description: Any other Pixel Lab request fields for this operation (image_size, view, outline, shading, detail, direction, no_background, seed, template_id, tileset descriptions, etc.).

image_inputs.description: Map of API image field name → project-relative image path (or array of paths). e.g. {"reference_image":"assets/ref.png"} or {"style_images":["a.png","b.png"]}.

save_to.description: Folder slug under assets/pixellab/ to save into. Defaults to a slug from the description.

wait_seconds.description: For async ops, block and poll up to this many seconds before returning (default 0 = return job_id immediately). Use 60–120 for things you want in one turn.
